entries.speaker: Fishing Controls Part 2
entries.en: Press [clr 2][f 1 10 22][clr 27] when a fish bites to hook the fish before[n]it escapes.

entries.speaker: Fishing Controls Part 2
entries.en: Move the bobber icon with [f 1 10 43] into the red zone[n]and rapidly press [clr 2][f 1 10 22][clr 27] to reel it in. Avoid reeling[n]when the icon is outside the red zone.

entries.speaker: Fishing Controls Part 2
entries.en: The fishing rod has a set amount of durability.[n]If the bobber hits the gauge walls too often,[n]the line will break and the fish will escape.

entries.speaker: Fishing Controls Part 2
entries.en: Move the bobber icon with [f 1 10 82] into the red zone[n]and rapidly press [clr 2][f 1 10 22][clr 27] to reel it in. Avoid reeling[n]when the icon is outside the red zone.
